description: NaNd₄N₂I₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to six I atoms. There are a spread of Na-I bond distances ranging from 3.07-3.48 Å. There are four inequivalent Nd sites. In the first Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two N and four I atoms. Both Nd-N bond lengths are 2.32 Å. There are a spread of Nd-I bond distances ranging from 3.13-3.41 Å. In the second Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and five I atoms. Both Nd-N bond lengths are 2.34 Å. There are a spread of Nd-I bond distances ranging from 3.21-3.96 Å. In the third Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and four I atoms. Both Nd-N bond lengths are 2.31 Å. There are a spread of Nd-I bond distances ranging from 3.16-3.43 Å. In the fourth Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and six I atoms. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Nd-N bond length. There are a spread of Nd-I bond distances ranging from 3.22-3.99 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to four Nd atoms to form edge-sharing NNd₄ tetrahedra. In the second N site, N is bonded to four Nd atoms to form edge-sharing NNd₄ tetrahedra. There are seven inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Nd atoms. In the second I site, I is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na and four Nd atoms. In the third I site, I is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Nd atoms. In the fourth I site, I is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Nd atoms. In the fifth I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Nd atoms. In the sixth I site, I is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Nd atoms. In the seventh I site, I is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Nd atoms.
